arxiv-2103-04084.title: Zero-Sum Semi-Markov Games with State-Action-Dependent Discount Factors
arxiv-2103-04084.creator: Zhihui Yu, Xianping Guo, Li Xia, Business School, Sun Yat-Sen University, Guangzhou, China
arxiv-2103-04084.description: Abstract Semi-Markov model is one of the most general models for stochastic dynamic systems. This paper deals with a two-person zero-sum game for semi-Markov processes. We focus on the expected discounted payoff criterion with state-action-dependent discount factors. The state and action spaces are both Polish spaces, and the payoff function is ω \omega -bounded.

arxiv-2103-05212.title: Testing f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity with the simulated data of gravitational waves from the Einstein Telescope
arxiv-2103-05212.creator: Yu Pan 1 , Yuan He 1 , Jing-Zhao Qi 2∗ , Jin Li 3 , Shuo Cao 4† , Tonghua Liu 4 , and Jun Wang 5
arxiv-2103-05212.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yu Pan 1 , Yuan He 1 , Jing-Zhao Qi 2∗ , Jin Li 3 , Shuo Cao 4† , Tonghua Liu 4 , and Jun Wang 5. In this paper we analyze the implications of gravitational waves (GWs) as standard sirens on the modified gravity models by using the third-generation gravitational wave detector, i.e., the Einstein Telescope.

arxiv-2212-01918.title: Mapping dust attenuation and the 2175 Å bump at kpc scales in nearby galaxies Journal: APJ
arxiv-2212-01918.creator: Shuang Zhou, Cheng Li, Niu Li, Houjun Mo, Renbin Yan, Michael Eracleous, Mallory Molina, Caryl Gronwall, Nikhil Ajgaonkar, Zhuo Cheng, Ruonan Guo
arxiv-2212-01918.description: Abstract We develop a novel approach to measure dust attenuation properties of galaxies, including the dust opacity, shape of the attenuation curve and the strength of the 2175Å absorption feature. From an observed spectrum, the method uses a model-independent approach to derive a relative attenuation curve, with absolute amplitude calibrated using NIR photometry.

arxiv-2312-03276.title: An inverter-chain link implementation of quantum teleportation and superdense coding
arxiv-2312-03276.creator: Felix A. Buot, Roland E.S. Otadoy, and Xavier L. Bacalla
arxiv-2312-03276.description: Abstract A new perspective in terms of inverter-chain link (ICL) diagrams of quantum entanglement faithfully captures the fundamental concept of quantum teleportation and superdense coding. The ICL may be considered a series of σ x \sigma_{x} Pauli-matrix operations, where a physical/geometric representation provides the mysterious link raised by EPR.

arxiv-2401-16325.title: Making the unmodulated Pyramid wavefront sensor smart
arxiv-2401-16325.creator: R. Landman, S. Y. Haffert, J. R. Males, L. M. Close, W. B. Foster, K. Van Gorkom, O. Guyon, A. Hedglen, M. Kautz, J. K. Kueny, J. D. Long, J. Lumbres, E. A. McEwen, A. McLeod, L. Schatz
arxiv-2401-16325.description: Abstract Almost all current and future high-contrast imaging instruments will use a Pyramid wavefront sensor (PWFS) as a primary or secondary wavefront sensor. The main issue with the PWFS is its nonlinear response to large phase aberrations, especially under strong atmospheric turbulence.

arxiv-2402-06293.title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Irregularly Sampled Time Series with Missing Values via Conditional Normalizing Flows
arxiv-2402-06293.creator: Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi, Randolf Scholz, Stefan Born, Lars Schmidt-Thieme
arxiv-2402-06293.description: Abstract Probabilistic forecasting of irregularly sampled multivariate time series with missing values is crucial for decision making in various domains, including health care, astronomy, and climate. State-of-the-art methods estimate only marginal distributions of observations in single channels and at single timepoints, assuming a Gaussian distribution for the data.

arxiv-2410-02883.title: How Meteor Showers Can Guide the Search for Long Period Comets
arxiv-2410-02883.creator: Samantha Hemmelgarn, Nicholas Moskovitz, Stuart Pilorz, Peter Jenniskens
arxiv-2410-02883.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Samantha Hemmelgarn, Nicholas Moskovitz, Stuart Pilorz, Peter Jenniskens. With orbital periods longer than 200 years, most long-period comets (LPCs) remain undiscovered until they are in-bound towards perihelion. The comets that pass close to Earth’s orbit are Potentially Hazardous Objects (PHOs). Those with orbital periods up to ∼ \sim 4000 years tend to have passed close to Earth’s orbit in a previous orbit and produced a meteoroid stream dense enough to be detected at Earth as a meteor shower.

arxiv-2509-09593.title: Fluent but Unfeeling: The Emotional Blind Spots of Language Models
arxiv-2509-09593.creator: Bangzhao Shu, Isha Joshi, Melissa Karnaze, Anh C. Pham, Ishita Kakkar, Sindhu Kothe, Arpine Hovasapian, Mai ElSherief
arxiv-2509-09593.description: Abstract The versatility of Large Language Models (LLMs) in natural language understanding has made them increasingly popular in mental health research. While many studies explore LLMs’ capabilities in emotion recognition, a critical gap remains in evaluating whether LLMs align with human emotions at a fine-grained level.

arxiv-2509-17284.title: On the Quantization of the Electromagnetic Field with Magnetic Monopoles
arxiv-2509-17284.creator: Kanan Anwar
arxiv-2509-17284.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kanan Anwar. We present a covariant framework for the quantization of the electromagnetic field in the presence of magnetic monopoles. Building on the two-potential formalism of Cabibbo and Ferrari, which treats electric and magnetic sources on equal footing and reveals a U ⁡ ( 1 ) × U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1)\times U(1) gauge symmetry, we extend the theory into the quantum domain. Using the Gupta–Bleuler procedure in the Feynman-’t Hooft gauge, we construct the physical Hilbert space and eliminate negative-norm states.

arxiv-2602-10010.title: Magneto-optical study of Nb thin films for superconducting qubits
arxiv-2602-10010.creator: Amlan Datta, Kamal R. Joshi, Sunil Ghinire, Makariy A. Tanatar, Cameron J. Kopas, Jayss Marshall, Josh Y. Mutus, David P. Pappas, Matthew J. Kramer, Ruslan Prozorov
arxiv-2602-10010.description: Abstract Among the recognized sources of decoherence in superconducting qubits, the spatial inhomogeneity of the superconducting state and the possible presence of magnetic-flux vortices remain comparatively underexplored. Niobium is commonly used as a structural material in transmon qubits that host Josephson junctions, and excess dissipation anywhere in the transmon can become a bottleneck that limits overall quantum performance.

pmc-11536885.title: Nurses’ strategies for coping with stress in the face of the influx of war refugees from Ukraine to Poland
pmc-11536885.creator: Krystyna Kowalczuk, Katarzyna Tomaszewska, Andriej Szpakow, Elżbieta Krajewska-Kułak, Marek Sobolewski, Justyna Magdalena Hermanowicz
pmc-11536885.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionRussian military’s incursion into Ukraine sparked the largest refugee crisis in Europe since World War II. As Ukraine’s neighboring country, Poland became the primary destination for these refugees. Ukrainians staying in Poland under the EU’s Temporary Protection Directive receive humanitarian support similarly to asylum seekers, but the legal pathways, length of stay and integration processes differ significantly as the Directive provides for more immediate, collective protection without the complexity of individual asylum applications.

pmc-13550577.description: Person-centered approaches to social networks profiles and their association with digital health readiness (DHR) remain underexplored among rural older adults with hypertension. This study aimed to identify latent social networks profiles and examine their independent association with DHR in this population.

pmc-13674512.title: SIK2 antagonizes postinfarction cardiac repair by driving macrophage proinflammatory and impairing efferocytosis
pmc-13674512.creator: Wu-Wei Rong, Zi-Qi Xu, Shuai Shao, Qian-Wan Deng, Meng-Yao Li, Jin-Qiu Wei, Yi-Hang Yang, Jia-Jia Zhao, Wen-Hui Zhai, Zhi-Wen Shang, Zhi Zhang, Wen-Yi Yang, Shao-Wen Liu, Ping-Jin Gao, Xiao-Dong Li, Ji-Guang Wang
pmc-13674512.description: Macrophages play a key role in cardiac injury and repair after myocardial infarction (MI). Salt-inducible kinase 2 (SIK2), a member of the adenosine monophosphate–activated protein kinase family, is notably up-regulated in monocytes/macrophages of patients with MI and animal models. In this study, we investigated the role of SIK2 in macrophage-mediated inflammation and efferocytosis following MI.

uslaw-usc-t22-s3974.title: 22 U.S.C. § 3974 — Border equalization pay adjustment
uslaw-usc-t22-s3974.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s3974.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 52 (Foreign Service); Subchapter IV (Compensation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general An employee who regularly commutes from the employee’s place of residence in the continental United States to an official duty station in Canada or Mexico shall receive a border equalization pay adjustment equal to the amount of comparability.

uslaw-usc-t6-s797.description: United States Code, Title 6 (Domestic Security); Chapter 2 (National Emergency Management); Subchapter II (Comprehensive Preparedness System); Part D (Prevention Of Fraud, Waste, And Abuse).
